quote: We use the following prompt to implement the boundary classifier: You are a safety policy expert. Your task is to determine whether a given TEXT violates the safety policy below. Your decision must strictly follow the specific language used in the safety policy.

The full dataset contains 107,620 English-language texts from social media annotated by 17,280 annotators in total for toxicity levels. Each text has exactly 5 annotations and each annotator labeled 31 texts on average.
guideline: Annotators were asked to rate the toxicity of each instance on a 5-point scale from 0 (not at all toxic) to 4 (extremely toxic).
